g.text: C. Consumer threads created per tool call
Only first eligible non-final growth launches a consumer; zero eligible burst growth creates no thread. Final oracle is unchanged.
Resource reduction does not guarantee lower whole-task latency. Defaults unchanged; no snapshots or eviction.
Bars show independent group medians; paired differences in the report may have a different ordering.
